diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_launch_template.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng to :resource.aws_launch_template.ng duplicates the ASG's implicit reference to the launch template in its mixed_instances_policy.
The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng to :resource.aws_iam_role.ng duplicates the implicit dependency from its node_role_arn reference.

The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng to :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is already established transitively: the ASG depends on :resource.aws_launch_template.ng, which depends on the instance profile and IAM role.
